extension.description: Live preview of WPF XAML in VS Code using real WPF rendering (Windows only, .NET 10)
config.language.enum.auto: Follow the VS Code display language (the Windows language by default).
config.autoOpenPreview.description: Automatically open the preview when a .xaml file is opened. An existing preview panel is reused and refreshed.
config.autoBuildOnPreview.description: When the preview fails because the project has no build output (bin), build that project (.csproj) automatically and render again. Works only in trusted folders; if the build fails, the preview says so.
config.buildConfiguration.description: Configuration (dotnet -c) used by the right-click Build / Rebuild / Clean commands on .csproj/.sln.
config.buildTargetFramework.description: When right-click building a multi-target (<TargetFrameworks>) .csproj, build only this TFM (e.g. net10.0-windows). Applies only if that .csproj declares the TFM; never used for solutions or single-target projects. Leave empty to build all.
config.buildExtraArgs.description: Extra arguments appended as-is to the `dotnet` command of right-click Build/Clean/Restore (e.g. `["-p:RunAnalyzers=false"]`). Not read in untrusted folders.
config.language.description: Language of messages, status bar and preview toolbar. `auto` follows the VS Code display language (which follows the Windows language by default). Manifest texts such as menu titles follow the VS Code display language (Configure Display Language).
